headword: {働|はたら}き{方|かた}{改革|かいかく}
reading: はたらきかたかいかく

definitions.explanation: A broad Japanese government-led initiative launched around 2016–2019 to reform Japanese working practices — including capping overtime, encouraging paid-leave use, promoting remote work, and improving work–life balance. More generally, any movement or program aimed at changing how people work.

examples.japanese: {働|はたら}き{方|かた}{改革|かいかく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}める→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{働|はたら}き{方|かた}{改革|かいかく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{推進|すいしん}している→推進する：17281_suishinsuru⟧。
examples.english: The government is promoting work-style reform.

examples.japanese: {働|はたら}き{方|かた}{改革|かいかく}⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{残業|ざんぎょう}{時間|じかん}→残業時間：27558_zangyoujikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}った→減る：01985_heru⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to work-style reform, overtime hours have decreased.

examples.japanese: {働|はたら}き{方|かた}{改革|かいかく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一環|いっかん}→一環：17696_ikkan⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧、⟦{在宅勤務|ざいたくきんむ}→在宅勤務：06158_zaitakukinmu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{認|みと}められた→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧。
examples.english: As part of work-style reform, working from home was officially approved.

notes:
A political and social keyword in contemporary Japan, composed of ⟦{働|はたら}き{方|かた}→働き方：25439_hatarakikata⟧ (way of working) + ⟦{改革|かいかく}→改革：04815_kaikaku⟧ (reform). Originally a signature policy of the Abe government, formalized in the 2018 {働|はたら}き{方|かた}{改革|かいかく}{関連|かんれん}{法|ほう} (Work Style Reform Related Laws), which took effect in 2019. The term has since broadened to refer to any effort to reshape how people work.

- ⟦{長時間|ちょうじかん}→長時間：10165_choujikan⟧⟦{労働|ろうどう}→労働：03785_roudou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{是正|ぜせい}→是正：05631_zesei⟧: correcting long working hours
- ⟦{有給|ゆうきゅう}{休暇|きゅうか}→有給休暇：06996_yuukyuukyuuka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{取得|しゅとく}→取得：11947_shutoku⟧⟦{促進|そくしん}→促進：05632_sokushin⟧: encouraging use of paid leave
- ⟦{同一|どういつ}→同一：01759_douitsu⟧⟦{労働|ろうどう}→労働：03785_roudou⟧⟦{同一|どういつ}→同一：01759_douitsu⟧⟦{賃金|ちんぎん}→賃金：04842_chingin⟧: equal pay for equal work
- ⟦{多様|たよう}→多様：12180_tayou⟧な⟦{働|はたら}き{方|かた}→働き方：25439_hatarakikata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{推進|すいしん}→推進：12908_suishin⟧: promoting diverse ways of working (including telework and flextime)

CULTURAL NOTE:
The term reflects a broad societal reckoning with Japan's notoriously long working hours and overwork-related deaths (⟦{過労死|かろうし}→過労死：14324_karoushi⟧). It is frequently invoked in news, corporate announcements, and HR materials.
